readme: Gold cases for scripts/eval-match.ts. Each case: { age:int, feeling:string, expect:figureKey|"miss", note?:string }. Hard near-miss cases add { hard:true, plausibleWrong:figureKey, confusionGroup:string } so confusion is computable. expect:"miss" means NO figure fits — the case passes if framing comes back "partial" (an honest 'fragment that rhymes'), regardless of which figure is named. NOTE on library shape: with only 3 age-clustered figures (douglass ~20-23, butler ~26-28, lee ~50-54) and a +/-10y age gate, the only intra-pool confusable pair is butler<->douglass; lee is age-isolated and has no confusion partner until a similarly-aged figure is authored. The miss cases are deliberately age-in-range so they exercise the reranker's confidence calibration, not just the age gate. Expand this set as the library grows; a high top-1 with few hard pairs is unproven, not validated — weight authoring effort on hard confusionGroup cases.

cases.feeling: I keep getting rejected and I don't know if I should keep trying
I escaped and don't know who I am
I'm stuck in the wrong life and don't know how to leave
I just had my first child and I'm terrified I'll pass on my own father's temper
cases.note: intergenerational parenting fear; age sits in butler's window so the reranker must judge fit, not the age gate

cases.feeling: My husband of thirty years died last spring and the silence in the house is unbearable
cases.note: late-life bereavement; age in lee's window — single-candidate calibration test

cases.feeling: I can't stop gambling and the debt is crushing me but I can't tell anyone
cases.note: addiction + financial shame; age in douglass's window

cases.feeling: I've poured years into my work with nothing to show for it, and lately I just want to walk away and start over as someone new
cases.note: 'start over as someone new' pulls douglass's self-invention; the core is creative perseverance (butler)

cases.feeling: I cut off the people who defined my whole life and now I'm alone and have no idea who I am without them
cases.note: young self-invention after leaving (douglass); the only in-pool alternative at this age is butler
